title: Cranes and Lifting Appliances - Selection of Wire Ropes, Part 2: Mobile Cranes - Coefficient of Utilization
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13870 (PART 2)) covers Cranes and Lifting Appliances - Selection of Wire Ropes, Part 2: Mobile Cranes - Coefficient of Utilization. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 4308-2 : 1988 'Cranes and lifting appliances — Selection of wire ropes — Part 2 Mobile cranes — Coefficient of utilization', issued by the internatronal Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), was adopted by the ( HMD 10 ) and approval of the Heavy Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard has been issued in two parts. The other part of the Standard is: IS 13870 ( Part 1 ) : 1993 Cranes and lifting appliances ~ Selection of wire ropes : Part 1 General The text of ISO standard has been approved for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are however not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' ^appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a full stop ( . ) a

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
